one-sense.plainEnglish: Co-op still has one look. The authority traces, and the alert flag replicates. A loud sound calls that same event on the authority. Each client that traces on its own makes the hunters disagree about a wall. The player's use trace still must not write the flag.
one-sense.whyGame: Two machines looking through different corners produce two hunters, and a local use that sets the flag alerts the house from empty air.

expansions.title: One owner
expansions.detail: The machine that owns the hunter traces.

expansions.title: The bottle
expansions.detail: It calls Sense on the authority, not a new component on every client.

expansions.title: Use
expansions.detail: The press stays local and does not write Alert.

quiz.prompt: Each co-op client runs the hunter look and the hunters disagree about a wall. Who should trace?
choices: The machine that owns the hunter
All machines, with the bools averaged
Only the player who threw the bottle
The client with the lowest ping
quiz.why: One owner. Clients do not vote.

quiz.prompt: The alert flag replicates after the authority trace. What do the other machines receive?
choices: The flag, not a second trace of their own
quiz.why: The result replicates. The look does not.

quiz.prompt: A bottle is thrown. Where should that call run?
choices: On the authority, through the same look
On every client, in a new component
quiz.why: Sound is still the shared look.

quiz.prompt: The player's use trace writes the alert flag on the pressing client. What alerts the house?
choices: Empty air, on that one machine
A real glimpse from the owner
quiz.why: Use must not write the flag.

quiz.prompt: Two clients report different hits and you average them. What can the average claim?
choices: A wall neither machine actually agreed on

quiz.prompt: Every co-op client should run its own hunter trace.
Which write is the co-op look?
choices: The alert flag, on the owning machine
A client-side flag that never replicates

quiz.prompt: A loud sound grows a second component on every machine. What does the stalk fail to read?
choices: The flag it was already taught

quiz.prompt: The owner is tracing and a client also traces through a different doorway. Which result should win?
choices: The client's, because it is closer to the player

quiz.prompt: What still stays local to the press, even in co-op?
choices: The authority check around the look
quiz.why: The press is the player's. The look is the hunter's.

hide.plainEnglish: A hide lever implements Interact. It does not get its own graph and it does not get a frame loop. The player's trace starts at the camera. The hunter does not run this call, and the hunter's overlap is not how you hide.
hide.whyGame: A trace from the actor location grabs the frame beside the lever, and a Tick on the lever traces the player forever.

expansions.title: The lever
expansions.detail: It answers Interact. The trace does not name the lever class.

expansions.title: The hunter
expansions.detail: Its overlap is not a hide button.

quiz.prompt: What does a hide lever implement?
The use trace hits the lever and calls the interface. What does that line accomplish?
choices: It runs the lever's own use function

quiz.prompt: The crosshair is on the lever and the trace starts at the actor location. What gets grabbed?
choices: The frame beside the lever, not the lever
The lever, because actor location is the crosshair

quiz.prompt: The lever is given a frame loop so the prompt feels instant. What traces forever?
choices: No trace at all, if a prop were unable to tick
quiz.why: The lever waits for the press.

quiz.prompt: The hunter's overlap is wired as the hide button. What hides the player?
quiz.why: Hide is a prop the player uses.

quiz.prompt: A hide lever needs its own event graph.
The hunter runs the hide call. What does the hunter start operating?
quiz.why: The hunter does not use props.

quiz.prompt: Where does the hide trace start?
Which call is the lever, not the hunter?
choices: Interact on the prop the player hit

quiz.prompt: Art adds a second hide spot. What does the use graph change?
choices: Nothing, if the new spot implements Interact
A new cast to the new mesh

fear.plainEnglish: Fear binds a dispatcher and broadcasts it from ApplyEffect once a second. Begin Play starts that timer once. The look only writes the alert flag. A creak calls the look. It does not broadcast fear, or every cupboard terrifies the player.
fear.whyGame: Broadcasting inside the glimpse shakes the camera on looks the design meant to forgive.

expansions.title: The glimpse
expansions.detail: It writes the flag. It does not shake the camera.

expansions.title: The cupboard
expansions.detail: The creak calls the look, not the dispatcher.

quiz.prompt: What does Begin Play start for fear?
choices: One timer that calls ApplyEffect each second

quiz.prompt: ApplyEffect broadcasts the dispatcher. What does that line accomplish?
choices: It tells listeners that fear just pulsed

quiz.prompt: Who should bind to that dispatcher?
choices: The camera shake and the fear UI
quiz.why: Listeners bind. They do not poll.

quiz.prompt: Fear is broadcast inside the glimpse, five times a second. What shakes too often?
choices: The camera, including glimpses meant to be forgiven
Only a cupboard that called the look
No shake at all, if a glimpse were unable to broadcast
quiz.why: Sight and fear have different periods.

quiz.prompt: A cupboard creak panics the player. Which call was wired to the sound?
choices: The fear dispatcher, where the look belonged
The timed glimpse, which is what a creak should call
quiz.why: The creak is not the pulse.

quiz.prompt: A door creak should broadcast fear.
The look writes the alert flag and also shakes the camera. What did sight steal?
choices: The press that calls a prop
quiz.why: The flag is sight. The shake is fear.

quiz.prompt: Begin Play starts a new fear timer every time the pawn spawns a second copy of the component. What piles up?
Which period is fear, not the glimpse?
choices: Only while the trigger is held

quiz.prompt: Which line is the pulse, not the look?
choices: The alert flag written on a hit
A curve played from the start

quiet-save.plainEnglish: A horror save packs the alert flag, whether the door is open, the patrol direction, and health. It does not pack the hinge transform, the fear bindings, or the timer handle. Begin Play binds listeners again and starts timers after the bools are applied. Playing a door from the start on load creaks the hunter awake.
quiet-save.whyGame: A replayed creak calls the look and wakes a house you loaded as calm.

expansions.title: The bool
expansions.detail: Set the curve to the end that matches IsOpen.

expansions.title: The bindings
expansions.detail: Rebuild them. Do not save them.

expansions.title: Order
expansions.detail: Apply the door, then start the look.

quiz.prompt: Which set belongs in the co-op horror slot?
choices: The alert flag, the open bool, the patrol direction, and health
The hinge transform and the fear delegate bindings

quiz.prompt: A finished struct is on disk. What happens before the look timer starts?
choices: The creak plays from the start

quiz.prompt: Loading an open door calls PlayFromStart. What wakes?
choices: The creak, and then the hunter
quiz.why: Set the curve to the end.

quiz.prompt: You pack the hinge transform so the door matches. What are you storing?
choices: A pose the open bool already describes
The only copy of the alert flag

quiz.prompt: The look starts before the loaded door is applied. What does the hunter gain?
choices: A glimpse through a doorway that should already be closed
A silent curve at the open end

quiz.prompt: Fear delegate bindings belong in the horror save.
The patrol direction loaded and the alert flag did not. What chase is wrong?
choices: One that continues while the loaded flag says the route
A door that opens because the hunter faces one way
A hide lever that works because of direction
A fear pulse that uses the route as its timer
quiz.why: The flag decides chase versus route.

quiz.prompt: When should the night struct be written?
choices: Every rendered frame while the flag decays
quiz.why: Finished moments, then load at Begin Play.

quiz.prompt: Begin Play after load should do which pair?
choices: Bind listeners again, then start timers
Skip the bools and start the look immediately
Write the hinge and skip the flag
quiz.why: Rebuild machinery after the values are in place.

quiz.prompt: Which object is a handle you must not pack?
quiz.why: The timer is started again. It is not a value.
